en: Colorized historic postcard view of a broad public square with statues and trees set against a mountainous backdrop. A large monument with a standing figure on a high pedestal is visible on the left, while a bust on a plinth stands on the right. People and horse‑drawn vehicles appear in the square. Printed red text at the top left reads "TRENTO – TRIENT Piazza Dante," and there is cursive handwriting across the upper center.
